items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: He said he got that idea from me.

ctx.x: He said he got that idea from me. He said before I even was in your band I did. He was originally from the east somewhere and he said Flip got that from him.

Look at the picture of him, long before Flip Wilson became famous, it is unbelievable, but it's just like he's doing-- Leon looks like he's doing that Geraldine routine and that came long before Flip Wilson
